newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Police say six killed in shooting rampage-Radio NZ.
newsitem.headline: Police say six killed in shooting rampage-Radio NZ.

text.p: New Zealand police said six people were shot dead and up to five seriously wounded on Saturday after a gunman went on a shooting rampage in a central North Island town, Radio New Zealand reported.
Police have arrested the gunman who they said was related to some of the dead and wounded.

The shooting occurred around 9:00 a.m. (2000 GMT Friday) in the small town of Raurimu, which lies near Mount Ruapehu, an active volcano. Radio New Zealand said police made the announcement at a news conference in nearby Taumarunui town.
The wounded were ferried by helicopters to hospitals in the district, it said. Raurimu was evacuated after the shooting.
Police said the gunman, believed to be a 50-year-old local resident, was arrested close to the scene.
A helicopter pilot Guy Beange, who was called out to assist in the operation, said police were still scouring the largely bush area for more victims.
